title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Contract Summary — Plan Changes and Drop Timing
content:
Residential Natural Gas Supply customers may move to another Beacon Ridge gas plan before their term ends, and a cancellation drop follows the utility's meter-reading calendar. The contract summary terms per plan are:

| Plan | Mid-term move to another Beacon Ridge gas plan allowed | When a mid-term plan change takes effect | When a cancellation drop takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | Yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | Yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | Yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | Yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | Yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | Yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | Yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |

### Summary in plain terms

- Every plan allows a mid-term move to another Beacon Ridge gas plan, and the change takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle, never mid-cycle.
- On every plan a cancellation takes effect on the premise's next scheduled meter read, not on the day the customer calls.
- *Hypothetical:* a customer whose current billing cycle runs to 14 March and whose next cycle starts 15 March has a plan change take effect on 15 March; a cancellation confirmed on 2 March at a premise whose next scheduled meter read is 20 March has its drop take effect on 20 March.
